options: Angular momentum $\vec{L}=m \vec{r} \times \vec{v}$ is a constant of motion.
Vector $\vec{J}=m \vec{r} \times \vec{v}+e \gamma \vec{r} / r$ is a constant of motion.
Kinetic energy of the particle is constant.
Total flux of the magnetic field through a sphere centered at the origin is a non-zero constant.

options: The magnetic force on the lower wire is in the vertically downward direction.
